title: Mass defect, packing fraction, binding energy per nucleon
topicTitle: Mass defect, packing fraction, binding energy per nucleon
notes: **Fact.** Mass defect Δm = Z m_p + N m_n − M; binding energy BE = Δm c²; BE per nucleon peaks near Fe-56 (~8.8 MeV).
**Fact.** Radioactive decay: N = N₀e^(−λt), t_½ = ln2/λ; activity A = λN.
**Fact.** Fission (heavy nucleus → two + 2–3 n + ~200 MeV); fusion (light → heavy + energy, powers stars).
